description:
Schedule and post to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Threads and Bluesky from a single message. 1Social fits each caption to the network's limit, warns when a network needs an image, and schedules posts up to 30 days ahead.

After publishing it reports each network separately — what landed, what failed and why — and can retry one network without touching the rest. Edit or cancel anything still scheduled.

defaultPrompt: Write a short post announcing our new feature and publish it to all my connected accounts
Schedule a post about our end-of-month update for tomorrow at 9am
Which of my posts got the most likes?
